description: Joining a banking backend project using Java, Spring WebFlux, event-driven architecture, RabbitMQ, and Azure.

Contributed to an enterprise application with Claude Code, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Java, and Spring MVC. Applied Hexagonal Architecture with PostgreSQL, Kafka, Docker, and Azure; reviewed frontend, backend, security, and data implementations and validated increments before QA handoff.

Developed reactive APIs and microservices with Java, Spring WebFlux, and .NET. Built data integration with Apache NiFi, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and SQL; worked with RabbitMQ, CQRS, API-key authentication, and caching. Used Docker and Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, and GCP, with Grafana, Elastic Stack, and OpenTelemetry.
Developed React and Node.js features within micro frontends and decoupled services. Worked with AWS Lambda, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, and CloudWatch, applying Hexagonal Architecture.

Trained with .NET, Node.js, Angular, and React; built reactive flows with Rx.NET and RxJS and real-time communication with WebSockets. Applied DDD and Hexagonal Architecture with MongoDB, SQL Server, Express, and Docker.
